findings.description: Critical: roadmap references are restricted to `ri-NN` item IDs, but multiple live roadmap artifacts use valid IDs such as `dg-00`, `pca-01`, `artifact-header-schema`, and `dispatcher-daemon`. For any active change owned by one of those items, `_roadmap_refs` reports a malformed reference and drops `roadmap_ref` instead of rehydrating the required `<roadmap-id>:<item-id>` link.
findings.resolution: Widen the roadmap-reference contract and `_ROADMAP_REF_RE` to accept every item ID allowed by the canonical roadmap schema, update both canonical and change-local supervisor-record schemas identically, and add a regression fixture whose matching roadmap item uses a non-`ri-NN` ID.

findings.description: none: the implementation keeps derivable `active_changes` out of the durable mirror and centralizes normalization, selection, schema validation, and atomic mirror writes in the deterministic host-assisted module.
findings.resolution: Preserve this derivable/non-derivable boundary in later schema versions.

findings.description: none: the handoff extension preserves the pre-extension positional dataclass constructor and ordinary handoff behavior while adding opt-in `supervisor_record` transport and pre-limit `supervisor_only` filtering across database, service, HTTP, MCP, CLI, and bridge surfaces.
findings.resolution: Keep the new fields optional and retain the SQL defaults in future revisions.
